annotations.title: Court fee finder by form (EX50: N244, N245, N293A, N379 and more)

description: Finds the civil court fee in England and Wales for a court form or a step, by form number or in words (for example "N244", "N245", "warrant of control", "set aside a CCJ", "Tomlin order", "charging order"): each fee with its fee number in Schedule 1 to the Civil Proceedings Fees Order 2008, when it is paid, notes with their source, and our reading, labelled as such, where neither the Order nor the EX50 ties the fee to the form. Forms with no court fee say so. Fees in force from 13 July 2026. Help with fees is not taken into account. For the fees across a whole claim, use calculate_civil_court_fees. In the structured data, amounts are in pence; the text gives pounds.

query.description: A form number or a step, e.g. "N244", "N245", "warrant of control", "set aside a CCJ" or "Tomlin order". A form number keeps only the entries for that form.
